verdict.rationale: Numeral documents an official MCP server: a single HTTPS endpoint exposing nexus, filings, registrations, transactions, sales, products and exemption certificates as agent-callable tools. It has a dedicated tools reference page, and any MCP-capable client such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Cursor connects with the existing secret API key; a probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP endpoint works as documented.
